V4_MUSIC_OPENING.decision: Five music/teaching/service masses plus separately anchored two Eighth dormitory masses; petal performance forms, U courts and covered connections.

V4_CAMPUS_CONTEXT.decision: Separate motor road and greenway vocabulary; upper residential, middle landscape/descent and lower academic platform; hill context.

V4_MUSE_FACILITIES.decision: Three dormitory masses, exact subdivision/spacing inferred.

V4_DILIGENTIA_FACILITIES.decision: Three A/B/C dormitory masses; inferred roof rhythm.

V4_SHAW_FACILITIES.decision: Three interconnected blocks per East/West ensemble.

V4_COLLEGE_NAMES.decision: Current physical names; retain legacy identifiers as stable internal IDs.
